rules.static: No state, no machine: Kbd is a styled native <kbd>, nothing more. One Kbd per key; compose several inline for a chord.
rules.content: Content is the key's own label/glyph (e.g. "⌘", "Esc", "K") — Kbd does not translate a keyboard event into text for you.

Kbd.chord: <Text as="span">Press <Kbd>⌘</Kbd> <Kbd>K</Kbd> to open the command palette</Text>
